entries.gloss: the water is running (jārī), not standing: judged jirya by jirya

anchor.excerpt_ar: الماء الجاري

entries.gloss: the part in question is the animal's hair or nail, which counts as detached from it

anchor.excerpt_ar: شعر الحيوان في حكم المنفصل عنه لا في حكم المتصل، وكذلك الظفر

entries.gloss: the excess over what suffices is distinct and separable from it (a voluntary addition on its own)

anchor.excerpt_ar: إن كانت الزيادة متميزة منفصلة

entries.gloss: the whole was originally the duty and part of it was dropped as a lightening (the traveller's four)

anchor.excerpt_ar: ما كان الأصل فرضيته ووجوبه ثم سقط بعضه تخفيفا

entries.gloss: the excess is performed in following an imām, where it may count as the obligatory (the latecomer's rukūʿ)

anchor.excerpt_ar: تجري الزيادة مجرى الواجب في باب الاتباع خاصة

entries.gloss: the cause of the obligation (sabab al-wujūb) has occurred before the act is advanced

anchor.excerpt_ar: ويجوز تقديمها بعد سبب الوجوب

entries.gloss: the advanced act was his duty as things stood when he performed it, so he was discharged by it

anchor.excerpt_ar: كان فرضه في الظاهر فبرئ به

entries.gloss: an expiation advanced by fasting, the oath then broken while he is well off (the state at obligation changed)

anchor.excerpt_ar: إذا كفر بالصوم قبل الحنث ثم حنث وهو موسر

entries.gloss: what the prohibition attaches to: the worship itself, a condition specific to it, a condition not specific to it, or what is no condition

anchor.excerpt_ar: إن كان التحريم عائدا إلى ذات العبادة على وجه يختص بها لم يصح، وإن كان عائدا إلى شرطها

entries.gloss: the wording is one whose meaning counts and not its letter (contract and divorce formulae)

anchor.excerpt_ar: ما يعتبر معناه دون لفظه

entries.gloss: the speaker is able to say the Arabic wording (its letter counts only with ability)

anchor.excerpt_ar: ما يعتبر لفظه مع القدرة عليه دون العجز عنه

entries.gloss: the obligation's time is narrow (muḍayyaq), not extended

anchor.excerpt_ar: وإن كانت مضيقة لم تصح على الصحيح

entries.gloss: the voluntary act is financial (ṣadaqa before the due zakāt), the carve-out from narrowness

anchor.excerpt_ar: وأما الزكاة فقال الأصحاب يصح أن يتنفل بالصدقة قبل أدائها وإن كانت على الفور

entries.gloss: the transmitted forms are substitutes for one another, so they are not combined

anchor.excerpt_ar: فأحد اللفظين بدل عن الآخر ولا يصح الجمع بين البدل والمبدل

entries.gloss: a cause fit to produce the effect is established in its locus

anchor.excerpt_ar: ووجدنا في محله علة صالحة له

entries.gloss: the apparent (ẓāhir) refers the effect to another cause, so aṣl and ẓāhir diverge

anchor.excerpt_ar: وقد تظهر الإحالة على غيرها فيختلفان

entries.gloss: binding both men costs no right (as purification does), unlike forcing one to cut his ownership

anchor.excerpt_ar: بخلاف إيجاب الطهارة عليهما فإنه لا ضرر فيه

entries.gloss: each man is certain of his own prior purity and doubts only the breach

anchor.excerpt_ar: كل واحد منهما متيقن للطهارة شاك في الحدث

entries.gloss: the matters are separate, each kept on its own aṣl rather than carrying the other's corollary

anchor.excerpt_ar: فيبقى في كل منهما على أصله

entries.gloss: the one noble act and the many acts cost the same time (or money)

anchor.excerpt_ar: وصلاة أربع ركعات في زمن واحد

entries.gloss: the duty in question is a making-up (qaḍāʾ), for which ability to perform is required

anchor.excerpt_ar: وأما قضاء العبادات فاعتبر الأصحاب له إمكان الأداء

entries.gloss: the growth is generated from the thing's substance, not from earnings

anchor.excerpt_ar: النماء المتولد من العين حكمه حكم الجزء

entries.gloss: the refusal is forbidden to him: what is asked of him he may not withhold

anchor.excerpt_ar: من حرم عليه الامتناع

entries.gloss: what is asked of him is a bare permission (idhn), not a disposition (taṣarruf)

anchor.excerpt_ar: أن يكون المطلوب منه إذنا مجردا

entries.gloss: the due right attaches to the property itself

anchor.excerpt_ar: إن كان الحق متعلقا بالمال نفسه لم يسقط

entries.gloss: the right attaches to the owner for a reason that ceases when the property leaves him

anchor.excerpt_ar: وإن كان متعلقا بمالكه لمعنى زال بانتقاله عنه سقط

entries.gloss: the attached or generated thing is one that follows the thing in sale

anchor.excerpt_ar: أن ما يتبع العبد من الثياب في البيع يتبعه هاهنا

entries.gloss: the benefit of the destroying or spoiling act goes to another, not to the actor

anchor.excerpt_ar: وإن كان النفع يعود إلى غيره فعليه الضمان

entries.gloss: the other of the two acts causing the loss was permitted

anchor.excerpt_ar: إذا حصل التلف من فعلين أحدهما مأذون فيه

entries.gloss: the one who exceeded the tolerated amount is at fault (negligence, transgression), as the agent and the sacrificer are

anchor.excerpt_ar: لأن هذا لا ينسب فيه إلى تفريط وتعد بخلاف الوكيل والمضحي

entries.gloss: what was given out for the duty failed to count for it

anchor.excerpt_ar: ثم تعيبت فإنها لا تجزيه

entries.gloss: how the undertaking failed: corrupted after a binding start, prevented (iḥṣār), or the designated offering lost with or without fault

anchor.excerpt_ar: من شرع في عبادة تلزم بالشروع ثم فسدت

entries.gloss: the excepted benefit is for a known period

anchor.excerpt_ar: استثناء منفعة العين المنتقل ملكها من ناقلها مدة معلومة

entries.gloss: the transfer is one where an uncertain period does no harm (waqf, manumission: for his life)

anchor.excerpt_ar: لأن جهالة المدة هنا لا تؤثر

entries.gloss: the exception arises by law (ḥukmī), not by stated wording, and so tolerates uncertainty

anchor.excerpt_ar: الاستثناء الحكمي هل هو كالاستثناء اللفظي أم تغتفر فيه الجهالة بخلاف اللفظي

entries.gloss: the benefits are owed to another under a binding contract (lease, marriage)

anchor.excerpt_ar: استحقاق منافع العبد بعقد لازم

entries.gloss: the contract by which the benefit was owned is perpetual and commutative (nikāḥ)

anchor.excerpt_ar: وإن كان عقد معاوضة وهو النكاح انفسخ بملك الرقبة

entries.gloss: the new holder succeeds the lessor in his property and takes ownership from him (heir, buyer, ward come of age)

anchor.excerpt_ar: أن ينتقل الملك إلى من خلفه في ماله ويقوم مقامه ويتلقى الملك عنه

entries.gloss: a second, different contract comes upon the same thing after the first

anchor.excerpt_ar: في توارد العقود المختلفة بعضها على بعض

entries.gloss: the earlier contract is binding (here the loan is not)

anchor.excerpt_ar: ويسقط ضمان العارية لأنها ليست لازمة

entries.gloss: the later contract is binding (the pledge that comes upon the loan)

anchor.excerpt_ar: وعقد هذه الأمانة لازم

entries.gloss: the words can be taken as an allusion to another contract that is valid in that form

anchor.excerpt_ar: أو يجعل كناية عما يمكن صحته على ذلك الوجه

entries.gloss: the contract requires witnessing (nikāḥ), which cannot fall on an intention

anchor.excerpt_ar: سوى النكاح لاشتراط الشهادة عليه وهي لا تقع على النية

entries.gloss: the ruling attaches to the thing itself as a binding right, not to one ownership

anchor.excerpt_ar: النوع الثاني ما يتعلق الحكم فيه بنفس العين من حيث هي تعلقا لازما

entries.gloss: the holder of the right consented to its lapse (without his consent it does not lapse)

anchor.excerpt_ar: والظاهر أن الرهن لا يبطل بعد لزومه بدون رضى المرتهن

entries.gloss: a right is bound to the destroyed thing as a binding attachment

anchor.excerpt_ar: إذا تعلق بعين حق تعلقا لازما

entries.gloss: the property came into his hand with its owner's consent (a trust)

anchor.excerpt_ar: الأمانات التي حصلت في يد المؤتمن برضى صاحبها

entries.gloss: the property held is guaranteed (maḍmūn) by him

anchor.excerpt_ar: الأعيان المضمونة فتجب المبادرة إلى الرد بكل حال

entries.gloss: the holder withholds the thing from its owner rather than offering it

anchor.excerpt_ar: فإن كان ممتنعا من تسليمه فهو غاصب إلا حيث يجوز الامتناع من التسليم

entries.gloss: the contract's ending came by a cause of the one holding the thing, alone or shared

anchor.excerpt_ar: إن كان انتهاء العقد بسبب يستقل به من هو في يده كفسخ المشتري أو يشارك فيه الآخر

entries.gloss: the void contract is of the binding kind (lāzim), not the permissive

anchor.excerpt_ar: والنوع الثاني: العقود اللازمة

entries.gloss: the contract carries a ruling built on predominance and spreading (nikāḥ, kitāba)

anchor.excerpt_ar: ما يترتب عليه حكم مبني على التغليب والسراية والنفوذ فهو منعقد

entries.gloss: the liability is a contract liability (ḍamān ʿaqd), measured by the named consideration, not a liability for loss

anchor.excerpt_ar: ضمان المهر في النكاح الفاسد ضمان عقد كضمانه في الصحيح

entries.gloss: taking possession is part of the contract's completion (salam, ribawī exchange), not merely its effect

anchor.excerpt_ar: أن يكون القبض من تمام العقد

entries.gloss: the forced acquisition is by necessity (the starving man taking another's food)

anchor.excerpt_ar: التملك الاضطراري كمن اضطر إلى طعام الغير

entries.gloss: the forced acquisition is the taking by pre-emption (shufʿa)

anchor.excerpt_ar: التمليكات المشروعة لإزالة ضرر ما كالأخذ بالشفعة

entries.gloss: the act is not itself due by the law's origin (nikāḥ, liʿān), so he need not learn the Arabic
entries.unanchored: the qāʿida leaves nikāḥ with ability to learn at two wujūh («ومع القدرة على التعلم فيه وجهان»); the ground that what is not due needs no learning is al-Kashshāf's («لأن النكاح غير واجب بأصل الشرع فلم يجب تعلم»), introduced by the refinement

entries.gloss: the pre-emptor is solvent for the price
entries.unanchored: the qāʿida names no solvency condition: it reports two wujūh on owning the shufʿa before payment; «إذا كان مليئا بالثمن» is al-Inṣāf's and al-Iqnāʿ's condition, introduced by the refinement
